treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Estonia and the State of Israel for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2009)
eif_quote: Estonia MoF table (No. | Jurisdiction | Initialled | Signed | Ratified | In force from | Effective from | MLI effective from): 28. | Israel | 15.06.2007 | 29.06.2009 | 25.11.2009 ( est/eng ) | 28.12.2009 | 01.01.2010 |
source_title: EE-IL Convention 2009 with Protocol (Riigi Teataja, est/eng)

rates.quote: a) 0 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
1. Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.quote: Estonia reserved MLI Art. 35(7)(a); its Art. 35(7)(b) notifications (25.11.2021, 01.06.2022) do not include this treaty, so the MLI (incl. PPT) has not yet effect.

notes: Dividends exempt when paid to the other State's Government/local authority/Central Bank or to pension funds (Art. 10(3)). Interest exempt when paid to Government/local authority/Central Bank, on loans guaranteed/insured by a wholly state-owned trade finance/insurance institution, or to pension funds (Art. 11(3)); credit-sale interest falls under Art. 7 (Art. 11(4)). Protocol para 3 preserves domestic anti-avoidance rules. Dividend 0% tier drafted as a 0% cap.
